2.1.evidence:
(1) In organizing protection for victims of gender-based violence and violence against children, the regional government shall cooperate with the Central Government, Provincial Government and Regency/City Government and other institutions.
(2) Cooperation between the Regional Government and the Central Government and Provincial Government as referred to in paragraph (1) shall include consultation, coordination and reporting.
(3) Cooperation between the Regional Government and Regency/City as referred to in paragraph (1) shall include coordination, advocacy, referral, repatriation, social reintegration, facilitation of Integrated Service System development, monitoring, evaluation and reporting.
2.1.rationale: The policy explicitly establishes cooperation between the regional government and multiple other government levels (central, provincial, and regency/city) and specifies that this cooperation includes consultation, coordination, reporting, referrals, monitoring, and evaluation—constituting a formal coordination mechanism/network for implementing protection and response services.
